name: lead-quality-none-called
about: LQ3c: a young campaign whose leads nobody has called yet: no share of the called, no minutes to the first call, one lead that missed a hard requirement.

output.headline: 2 campaigns ran on November 3, 2026, spending $284.25 across 14,600 impressions and 203 clicks to bring in 7 leads at a $40.61 cost per lead.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet led the day: $184.50 spent, 9,120 impressions, 141 clicks at 1.5%, 6 leads at $30.75 each. Dedicated night runs added 1 lead at $99.75 on $99.75 spent, 5,480 impressions, 62 clicks at 1.1%.
Month-to-date spend on Meta for 2026-11 sits at $612.30 with 28 days left in the month.

The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads, mature): 33 contacted, 17 converted, 10 applied, 4 hired, 8 lost after conversion. The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads, mature): 36 contacted, 20 converted, 12 applied, 5 hired, 9 lost after conversion.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied — but is too young to judge rates.

Lead quality for Regional Class A — Joliet over the last 14 days: 4 leads, none called yet so no median time to first call, and 1 missed a hard requirement — that is 25.0% of the campaign's leads, worth watching as calls get made.
